reviews.title: App
reviews.text:
The app is really great, but the ads are ridiculous. There is no reason on why every time I open the app there’s an ad , I could be looking up the time to pray and the prayer could probably go out any minute and once I open the app too see what time is to pray before the next prayer comes in there’s a whole like 1-2 min ad where it’s almost impossible to find the X button and some of the ads contain music and some people may be in the mosque !! But they ( the creators of the app) probably can’t control that so it’s not there fault, I think that the ads are OK, but not as soon as you open the app or as soon as you click a certain navigation tab on the app , I think that they should be mindful of those who may be in a rush to figure out which way the Qibla is or even just figure out what time it is to pray because they might miss there prayer .. But !! it is a good app overall aljumdilillah however I will be switching back to another app. May Allah help them grow and improve ! Ameen

reviews.title: Fiqh options
reviews.text: This app no longer shows Hanafi Asr prayer times, which is a serious drawback. On top of that, the app now seems more focused on making money than serving users, with excessive ads everywhere. When I’m in a rush for Salah and quickly need to check the prayer time, I’m forced to deal with ads or to upgrade by paying. Accessing basic Salah times should not require a payment or unnecessary delays. This has made the app far less reliable and user-friendly than before.
